title: Starlight page front matter
description: The front matter of a Markdown or MDX file under src/content/docs/. It lists the keys Starlight's docs schema reads; add your own keys with a description, or the build rejects the page.

banner.description: An announcement banner at the top of this page, instead of the site-wide one.

content.description: The banner text. HTML is allowed.

description.description: One sentence about the page, for search results and link previews.

draft.description: true keeps the page out of production builds; the development server still serves it.

editUrl.description: Where a reader can edit this page: a URL that overrides the site's edit link, or false to hide the link.

head.description: Extra tags for this page's head, such as meta and link.

hero.description: The hero shown on a splash page, or false for none.

icon.description: The name of an icon to show in the button.

image.description: An image beside the hero text.

alt.description: Text that describes the image for screen readers.

file.description: The image file, relative to src/assets/ by default.

tagline.description: A line under the hero title.

title.description: The hero's title, instead of the page title.

lastUpdated.description: When the page last changed: a date, or false to hide it.

next.description: The next link in the page's footer: a URL, false for none, or text and a link.

pagefind.description: false leaves the page out of the search index.

prev.description: The previous link in the page's footer: a URL, false for none, or text and a link.

sidebar.description: How the page appears in the sidebar.

attrs.description: HTML attributes for the sidebar link.

badge.description: A badge beside the sidebar link: text, or text and a variant.

hidden.description: true leaves the page out of an autogenerated group.

label.description: The link text, instead of the page title.

order.description: The page's position among its siblings: lower comes first.

tableOfContents.description: The page's table of contents: settings, or false for none.

template.description: The layout: doc for a normal page, splash for a wide landing page without sidebars.

title.description: The page title, shown as the page's heading, in the browser tab, and in the sidebar.
